start: ^You pull yourself out of the memory.
^The air is still now, nothing like the chaos before. But the problem has not gone anywhere.
^You look around. Most of your gear is gone.
^What is left is Marcus's backpack and the compass in Sierra's hand.
^Marcus is breathing hard, gripping his swollen leg.
^Sierra hit the ground hard when we ran. Now she will not even look at you.
^But we all know something is not right.
^You try to say something, but Sierra speaks first.
^"So this is how we end up out here, because of you?"
^"If it were not for us, you would be halfway down that river by now. You always think you know best."
^"That is not fair. We are still alive. We will get out of this. Together."
^"Brilliant speech. What is next, a sermon?"
^"Marcus, listen. I will get us out of here. But I need your help."
^"And you too, Sierra. I can see the compass. I need it."
^"You are both injured. That means it is on me now. But only if we work together."
^For a moment, Sierra does not respond. She stares at you, her fingers tightening around the compass.
^Maybe it is what you said. Or maybe it is that stubborn confidence in your voice.
^"You want my compass? So you can wander off again?"
^"If I keep it, at least we will not lose anything else valuable when you get yourself killed."
^Your throat tightens. You know she is not entirely wrong.
^"Come on, Sierra. I am trying to help."
^"You could have started by being more careful."
^"Wait. My bracelet. It is gone. Where is it? No. No."
^Her breathing becomes uneven. Panic creeping in.
^And you cannot help thinking this is not the time to worry about a bracelet. We need to get out of this forest.
^You glance at Marcus, unable to lift his leg without pain, and force yourself to stay calm.
^When we were running, we passed an abandoned campsite.
^"Marcus, give me the pack. I will go back and look for our things."
^After a moment of silence, Marcus speaks quietly.
^"That is all I have got left, Tyler. Do not mess this up."
